description: This file contains utility functions for handling GitHub search queries, including filter detection and a search handler that interacts with the GitHub API to perform issue searches based on query parameters.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Checks if a query string contains a specific filter type.

methods.name: hasSpecificFilter
methods.description: Checks if a query string contains a specific filter with a specific value.

methods.name: hasRepoFilter
methods.description: Checks if a query string contains a repository filter.

methods.name: hasTypeFilter
methods.description: Checks if a query string contains a type filter.

methods.name: searchHandler
methods.description: Handles performing a GitHub issue search based on provided arguments and search type, returning the result or error.
